stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app to open the terminal for 12 hours.
stepUp.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
stepUp.locked: The terminal stays locked until you confirm it is you.
